species_universe: species with occurrence=1 on at least two distinct frozen pilot islands; fixed after pilot and identical for every scoring island

transformations.continuous_standardization: pilot-island mean and population SD; zero SD is terminal STOP
transformations.pilot_global_occupancy: for a pilot training row, exclude the focal island; for a confirmatory row, use all 65 pilot islands
transformations.within_archipelago_source: for a pilot training row, exclude the focal pilot island from numerator/denominator; for a confirmatory row, use all pilot islands in the same frozen archipelago

fitting.model: binary logistic regression by deterministic IRLS
fitting.penalized_coefficients: all non-intercept coefficients including categorical effects

primary_estimand: mean(C_minus_R3 heldout log loss | extreme_q75) minus mean(C_minus_R3 heldout log loss | non_extreme)
primary_support_rule: primary point estimate < 0 and archipelago-cluster bootstrap 95% upper confidence limit < 0
secondary_estimands: mean C_minus_R3 heldout log loss among extreme_q75 islands; predicted negative
overall mean C_minus_R3 heldout log loss; descriptive only
Type-specific C_minus_R3 contrast; exploratory secondary and cannot rescue primary

uncertainty.invalid_replicate_rule: discard replicate only if it contains no extreme or no non-extreme heldout island; report accepted count
